Classification: Independent static decode of the original 9A64 definition from identity-checked ROM bytes, with explicit checked byte-branch targets, byte-identical unchanged 9A64 body and full-image compile, and source maps bound to the exact image. No natural 9A64 execution, edit, MAME run, hardware or extension claim.

EvidenceClasses.romIdentity: Original ROM length, SHA1 and SHA256 checked before decode.
EvidenceClasses.listing: Reviewed MAME listing used as a static oracle for the selected span and listed sites, not as the source of branch semantics.
EvidenceClasses.checkpoint: Tracked encoding checkpoint used as a static oracle for the selected span, sites and recorded targets.
EvidenceClasses.nativeHandlerAssembly: Tracked 7984 native evidence supplies the LDD,U++ / BEQ797B / LEAY1,Y / JMPFC assembly cross-check.
EvidenceClasses.handlerDecode: Static deduction from the original 6809 bytes at 797B and 7984; no execution.
EvidenceClasses.identityCompile: In-memory unchanged decode and re-emit; no ROM file was written.
EvidenceClasses.naturalExecution: Not performed. No natural 9A64 branch execution or runtime path coverage is claimed.

Branches.EvidenceClass: Static decoded contract from original-ROM 6809 handlers 797B/7984: one unsigned byte operand at the operand address, forward target = operand address + operand byte. No natural 9A64 branch execution or runtime path coverage is claimed.

Static decoded contract from original-ROM 6809 handlers 797B/7984: one unsigned byte operand at the operand address, forward target = operand address + operand byte. No natural 9A64 branch execution or runtime path coverage is claimed.

Handlers.Semantics: LDAB ,Y reads the byte at Y without advancing; CLRA zero-extends it to an unsigned 16-bit value; LEAY D,Y replaces Y with operand-address + unsigned operand. No data cell is consumed.

LDD ,U++ pops one 16-bit data cell and tests it. When the cell is 0000, BEQ enters the 797B handler, so Y becomes operand-address + unsigned operand. When nonzero, LEAY 1,Y skips exactly the one-byte operand.

SourceMap.EvidenceClass: Direct static decode of the identity-checked original ROM bytes. Six cited sites are marked observed in the reviewed MAME listing; the byte-branch base and signedness are decoded from the original 6809 handler bytes at 797B and 7984. This is static original-ROM evidence, not natural or synthetic execution.

NegativeControls: Wrong ROM length and SHA1 are rejected before decode.
Wrong VM header, unsupported 9A64 token and token code-field pointer mismatch are rejected.
Branch target equal to its own operand is rejected as target-in-operand.
Branch target inside another token or at another instruction's operand is rejected as a non-boundary.
Branch target outside the definition span is rejected.

Forged branch plans with a missing model, operand/target mismatch, wrong operand width, wrong condition, wrong offset semantics, wrong handler, non-boundary target or out-of-span target are rejected despite full original-ROM identity.
A 9A64 operand edit at 9A68 remains unsupported by the existing 9ED9-only edit path.

Limitations: Only the six tokens used by 9A64 and the two checked byte-branch handlers are supported; this is not a general decoder.
